stem.en: North of the equator, one area of a weather map reads 1012 at its centre and another reads 984. Which describes the wind?

text.en: It blows out of the 984 area into the 1012 area, bending as the Earth turns.

feedback.en: Wind moves from high pressure to low, not low to high.

text.en: It blows in a dead straight line from the 1012 area to the 984 area.

feedback.en: The direction is right, but the Earth's rotation bends the path.

text.en: It stays where it is, because each area keeps its own air.

feedback.en: A pressure difference always sets air moving.

text.en: It blows out of the 1012 area into the 984 area, bending as the Earth turns.

feedback.en: Yes. Pressure sets the direction and rotation bends the path.

explanation.en: Air moves from high pressure to low pressure, so it flows out of the 1012 area into the 984 area. The Earth's rotation bends the path: clockwise out of a high and anticlockwise into a low, north of the equator.

hints.en: What does the Earth's rotation do to moving air?
